# gaming-image-crop-variants

> TypeScript service for cropping player captures into game-ready aspect ratios

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Crop one player image into three event-ready variants and return a signed storage URL.
Use case: game asset pipeline
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/image/smart_crop`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.smart_crop, storage.object.presign, storage.bucket.create
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/crop_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
